T: Every big event needs a bloke like Kenny.
D: A mockumentary following a cheerful Melbourne bloke who runs portable toilets for big events.
P: Serve the mains when Kenny works the Melbourne Cup.
S: the big day at the races in Melbourne
Smoked salmon on warm blinis with crème fraîche, cooked prawns in shot glasses with a little Marie Rose sauce, and asparagus spears wrapped in prosciutto.
Sausage mince with grated onion and carrot rolled in puff pastry, egg washed, sesame on top, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Tomato sauce.
Thick chips double fried at 140C then 190C, tossed in chicken salt, with gravy for dipping.
M: his trip to the convention in Nashville
Chicken thighs brined in buttermilk, dredged and fried at 165C, brushed with hot oil spiked with cayenne, brown sugar and paprika, on white bread with pickles.
tea at his grumpy dad's place
Lamb loin chops rubbed with rosemary, garlic and salt, grilled hot for 3 minutes a side and rested, with buttery mashed potato, peas and a proper gravy from the pan juices.
W: Two sheets of puff pastry baked flat between trays, a thick custard of milk, eggs, sugar and cornflour poured between them, set overnight, topped with passionfruit icing and cut with a hot knife.
K: knock-off drinks after a long day on the job
Australian lager poured cold into pot glasses, a bowl of salted peanuts alongside.

s.note: the big day at the races in Melbourne
s.how: Top blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon. Toss 300g cooked prawns in mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce and spoon into shot glasses. Blanch asparagus spears for a minute, wrap in prosciutto and arrange everything on platters like a race day marquee.

Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, rinse and dry well. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes until soft, then drain and rest. Fry again at 190C until golden and crisp. Toss in chicken salt and serve with a cup of hot gravy for dipping.

m.note: tea at his grumpy dad's place
m.how: Rub 8 lamb loin chops with rosemary, garlic and salt. Grill hot for 3 minutes a side and rest. Boil 800g potatoes and mash with butter. Cook peas, then make gravy in the pan with the juices and 250ml beef stock. Serve it all on big plates.

w.how: Bake 2 puff pastry sheets flat between trays until crisp. Whisk 750ml milk, 3 eggs, 150g sugar and 80g cornflour over heat until very thick. Pour between the sheets in a lined tin and set overnight. Top with passionfruit icing and cut with a hot knife.

d.note: knock-off drinks after a long day on the job
d.how: Chill the lager and the pot glasses in the fridge for at least an hour. Pour each one slowly down the side of the tilted glass, finishing upright for a small head. Tip a bag of salted peanuts into a bowl and set it on the bar.
